reason: New test-only function asserting numStaleSeries bookkeeping around CompactSelectedSeries; it cannot affect production behavior.
headline: New test checks stale-series counter after CompactSelectedSeries eviction
summary: Adds a test that evicts a non-stale series and then a stale plus non-stale series via CompactSelectedSeries. It asserts that NumStaleSeries stays at 1 and then drops to 0. Test-only, so a short skim is enough.
